key_provisions_or_claims: Moves MDR and IVDR from Annex I Section A to Section B of the EU AI Act, limiting AI Act application to AI-enabled medical devices.
Commission may use delegated and implementing powers to set AI-specific requirements for devices, taking AI Act Chapter III Section 2 into account.
Notified bodies assessing high-risk AI medical devices must meet AI Act Article 31 requirements.
Reduces notified body involvement for lower and medium-risk devices, removes certificate validity limits, and streamlines notified body oversight through joint assessment teams.
Introduces regulatory sandboxes, breakthrough and orphan device pathways, and cybersecurity incident reporting to CSIRTs and ENISA.
annotation.summary_en: European Commission proposal (COM(2025) 1023) to simplify the Medical Devices and In Vitro Diagnostic Regulations. It reduces administrative burden, streamlines notified body conformity assessment, adds sandboxes and cybersecurity reporting, and moves the MDR/IVDR to Section B of Annex I of the EU AI Act to avoid overlapping requirements for AI-enabled devices.
annotation.title_clean: Proposal for a Regulation amending Regulations (EU) 2017/745 and (EU) 2017/746 as regards simplifying and reducing the burden of the rules on medical devices and in vitro diagnostic medical devices, and amending Regulation (EU) 2022/123 and Regulation (EU) 2024/1689
